verdict.rationale: First-party docs say only that Grok saves every conversation to disk automatically; they document no retention settings or deletion commands. Community reports describe config switches that limit what leaves the machine (disable_codebase_upload, telemetry/trace_upload off). They also say zero data retention is available only on the enterprise plan, and that the 'Improve the model' toggle reportedly has no effect on repo upload. missing for 10: documented retention/deletion controls for local sessions and server-side data, first-party docs for the upload-disable config, zero data retention outside enterprise, a verified working privacy toggle.
